summary: Trace extracellular voltage into putative units while making contamination, missed spikes and drift explicit.
outcomes: Explain detection, waveform features, clustering or template matching and curation.
Use several quality indicators without treating one threshold as ground truth.
sequence: Overlay spikes from multiple synthetic neurons
Track drift, splits, merges and collisions
Inspect refractory violations and completeness metrics
Validate against simulation or paired evidence

visual.question: Did a new unit appear, or did an old unit move?
visual.interaction: Inject gradual drift and overlapping spikes and compare sorter assignments.

practice.task: Run a bounded SpikeInterface analysis on synthetic or small open data.
practice.success: Reports contamination/completeness indicators, curation decisions and known ground-truth limits.
